material_class.structural_family: pentadecanuclear Ln hydroxy cluster; five edge-sharing {Ln4(μ3-OH)4} cubanes in a pentagonal ring centered by μ5-Cl

synthesis.procedure: PepCO2H·HCl (647 mg, 1.96 mmol, 0.59 equiv) was suspended in a stirred solution of KOtBu (1.017 g, 8.79 mmol, 2.67 equiv) in 20 mL methanol and stirred for 30 min at ambient temperature. A solution of [EuCl3·(H2O)6] (1.21 g, 3.30 mmol, 1.00 equiv) in 20 mL methanol was added dropwise, and the mixture was stirred for a further 45 min. DBMH (503 mg, 2.20 mmol, 0.67 equiv) in 20 mL methanol was added slowly through a dropping funnel. The turbid viscous mixture was stirred overnight at room temperature, filtered, and the filtrate evaporated to dryness in vacuo. The yellow residue was dissolved in 3 mL DMF, undissolved salt was filtered off, and slow diffusion of water into the mother liquor under reduced pressure gave large yellow crystals of 1 (701 mg) after two weeks. Yields are based on [LnCl3·(H2O)6]. The main text names the same reagents and methanol/KOtBu conditions but does not give reagent amounts.
synthesis.temperature: ambient temperature / room temperature; crystallization over two weeks
synthesis.time: 30 min, then 45 min, then overnight stirring; crystals after two weeks
synthesis.vessel_or_method: stirred methanol solution with dropwise addition via a dropping funnel, then DMF solution and vapor/liquid diffusion of water under reduced pressure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Filtration, evaporation of the filtrate, dissolution of the residue in 3 mL DMF, removal of undissolved salt, and slow diffusion of water into the DMF mother liquor under reduced pressure afforded yellow single crystals.

properties.summary: Compound 1 shows intense red Eu3+ f–f emission (580–700 nm) despite coordinated hydroxide. The main text reports a relative quantum yield of 19(1)% versus YVO4:Eu at 365 nm and an absolute quantum yield of 16(1)% at 400 nm; the abstract separately states an absolute quantum yield of 11(1)%. Confocal TRLLM imaging of HeLa cells shows intracellular emission near 617 nm.

synthesis.procedure: The same procedure as for 1 was used with [TbCl3·(H2O)6] (1.23 g, 3.30 mmol, 1.00 equiv) in place of the europium salt, together with PepCO2H·HCl (647 mg, 1.96 mmol, 0.59 equiv), KOtBu (1.017 g, 8.79 mmol, 2.67 equiv), and DBMH (503 mg, 2.20 mmol, 0.67 equiv) in methanol. After overnight stirring, filtration, evaporation, dissolution in 3 mL DMF, and slow diffusion of water under reduced pressure, orange crystals of 2 (585 mg) formed after two weeks. The main text names the reagents and reports the yield but does not give reagent amounts.

properties.summary: Compound 2 shows characteristic but weak Tb3+ f–f emission (550–650 nm). Its emission intensity and quantum yield are significantly lower than those of 1; the quantum yield is reported as less than 3%. In HeLa cells, TRLLM xyλ-scans give emission peaks at about 493, 553, and 595 nm.
